title: Evaluating and Improving Static Application Security Testing Tools for Rust
abstract: arXiv:2610.21373v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rust has become a popular systems programming language in recent years because of its strong guarantees on memory and concurrency safety. Many types of system software have been re-implemented in Rust. However, Rust programs can still suffer from common memory and concurrency vulnerabilities due to unsafe code and misunderstandings of its complex mechanisms. To mitigate such vulnerabilities, developers often rely on static application security testing (SAST) tools. However, the effectiveness of existing Rust SAST tools on real-world vulnerabilities remains underexplored. In this paper, we first conduct an empirical evaluation of mainstream Rust SAST tools using security vulnerabilities identified in real-world Rust applications. We systematically assess their effectiveness, uncover common weaknesses, and analyze the root causes behind them. translated_title: 评估与改进面向Rust的静态应用程序安全测试工具
translated_abstract: Rust凭借其对内存和并发安全性的强大保证，近年来已成为一种流行的系统编程语言，许多类型的系统软件都已用Rust重新实现。然而，由于不安全（unsafe）代码的存在以及对Rust复杂机制的误解，Rust程序仍然可能遭受常见的内存和并发漏洞。为了缓解此类漏洞，开发者通常依赖静态应用程序安全测试（SAST）工具。然而，现有Rust SAST工具在真实世界漏洞上的有效性仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们首先使用真实Rust应用程序中发现的安全漏洞，对主流Rust SAST工具进行了实证评估，系统地评估了它们的有效性，揭示了常见的弱点，并分析了这些弱点背后的根本原因。基于该研究，我们提出了TRUST，一种由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的自动化测试方法。
tldr: 本文通过真实漏洞对主流Rust静态安全测试工具进行实证评估，系统揭示其弱点及根本原因，并提出了基于大语言模型辅助的自动化测试方法TRUST来改进Rust安全测试工具。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically evaluates mainstream Rust static application security testing (SAST) tools on real-world vulnerabilities to uncover their weaknesses and root causes, and proposes TRUST, an LLM-assisted automated testing approach to improve Rust security testing tools.
